finding: A local infrastructure response to dead tenders and zero contactable prospects was promoted into company identity and then consumed as a strategic sequencing premise.
operating_rule: No recommendation becomes ACTIVE strategy without the required founder binding; interlock at publication and downstream consumption.
proof_or_recheck: Bid Readiness incident fired the reported interlock; independent registry replay remains separate from this continuation.

finding: Later operators repeatedly risked duplicating or contradicting earlier operators because actual predecessor threads and outputs were not consumed or their use was not receipted.
operating_rule: Every material predecessor/source receives a consumption-matrix row; titles and summaries do not prove consumption.
proof_or_recheck: D closeout fails if any material source lacks CONSUMED, DELIBERATELY_NOT_CONSUMED or UNAVAILABLE standing with consequence.

finding: A chat receipt or attempted write is not delivery when the intended durable destination was not written and read back.
operating_rule: Name destination, verify access, write, read back, retain receipt; switch to an authorised alternate route if the preferred route fails.
proof_or_recheck: Current GitHub files have commit receipts; Drive D receipt remains UNAVAILABLE to the current Desk principal and may not be claimed absent.

finding: Creating project containers and controls is useful infrastructure but does not by itself prove strategic differentiation, model allocation, prior-corpus use or continuity.
operating_rule: Judge project/lane topology by independent decision-changing functions, integrated results and successor utility, not object count.
proof_or_recheck: D must provide commission-to-delivery and lane/model ledgers plus a fresh successor continuity pass.

finding: Ahmed's impressions of Fable 5, Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol are useful hypotheses but not a binding universal model ranking.
operating_rule: Verify exact availability and compare candidate models on matched Obzio workloads; allocate by function rather than provider loyalty.
proof_or_recheck: SW return must include experiment registry, evidence and workload-level allocation matrix.

finding: The temporary coordination repository already contains a Metamate operating-estate bootstrap commission and predecessor state; current cohort work must recover and reconcile it before replacement.
operating_rule: Search existing SW agents, commissions, spaces, memories and returns before creating new cohort work; preserve useful coverage and supersede stale numeric floors.
proof_or_recheck: Current 16/08 draft is HISTORICAL_CANDIDATE_DO_NOT_SEND_UNCHANGED; recovered current cohort inventory is still open.

finding: A closing chat receipt does not make prior operator learning available at the next cold start.
operating_rule: A fresh successor must recover current strategy, lane state, holds, source locators and next actions from the declared minimum package without founder reconstruction.
proof_or_recheck: Required result PASS_CONTINUITY; self-certified or source-free receipt fails.

finding: In D's reported ChatGPT browser operation, repeated Send-button clicks silently no-op'd while Return submitted the lane.
operating_rule: Capture target-specific UI failures and proven alternate interaction paths in the capability register; do not generalise one UI event into universal product behaviour.
proof_or_recheck: Re-test on the exact live surface before consequential launch if behaviour may have changed.

finding: The current Desk Google Drive connector did not retrieve the Obzio Ops bus or D receipt, but this may reflect authenticated-principal or retrieval limits.
operating_rule: Record principal, path, query, time, result and limitation; never convert non-retrieval into universal absence.
proof_or_recheck: Verify the exact Drive principal, folder ID and object identity before routing or closure.

finding: The historical Metamate draft used a cumulative 50-agent exercise floor, while later founder direction treats approximate cohort counts as capacity signals rather than quotas.
operating_rule: Scale by justified functional decomposition and decision value; retain counts as telemetry, not proof of quality.
proof_or_recheck: SW cohort return must justify each retained/pilot function and report created, exercised, retained and disposed units separately where measured.
